name: Mistakes
overview: Scripture acknowledges that making mistakes is a reality of the human experience, but it offers assurance that God upholds those who fall and provides strength and help in times of weakness (Psalms 37:24; Isaiah 41:10). It emphasizes the importance of confessing and forsaking sins rather than hiding them, promising mercy to those who do so (Proverbs 28:13). Additionally, the Bible instructs believers to refrain from personal vengeance, trusting God as the righteous judge who will repay wrongdoing, while civil authorities serve as ministers of God to execute justice on evildoers (Matthew 5:38; Romans 12:19; Romans 13:4).
